reading.body:
Kevin Hern's AI record in this data is nine political committee contributions and four yea votes, with no sponsored AI bill listed.

The money is small and broad. Nine contributions between September 2025 and August 2026, eight of them $1,000 and one of $4,000 from Microsoft's PAC. The donors span the largest AI and cloud firms: Anthropic, Google, Intel, Microsoft, Oracle, Amazon. A member taking identical $1,000 checks from competing labs is not being bought by any one of them.

The votes are all procedural. Four recorded yeas, all on motions to suspend the rules and pass, which is the fast track used for noncontroversial bills. The data gives bill numbers and roll call numbers but no bill text, so it does not say what these bills would do about AI.

What this does not cover matters as much as what it does. There is no sponsored legislation here, no committee assignment, no hearing, no statement, and no vote on a contested AI bill. Thirteen events over roughly sixteen months is a thin record, and the page itself notes that date order is not a claim of causation. Nothing here shows money changing a vote, and nothing here shows the reverse either.

summary: Every dated AI event this site holds for Kevin Hern: bills sponsored or cosponsored, recorded votes on AI bills, and money from AI company and AI-focused political committees, newest first. 13 events.
